headline: As of 2026-10-13: 3,580,902 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 34 of 50 states, D+23.7 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 3,580,902 early/mail ballots cast so far across 34 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+23.7 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Florida (533,840), Virginia (531,373), Michigan (440,677).
